evidence.detail: The class owns one java.awt.Polygon, separate fill and outline java.awt.Color values, an optional String, and the source tile x/y integers used when the record represents a world-tile polygon.

Its tile-coordinate factory converts packet/world tile coordinates relative to Client.eh/ei into the client scene coordinate system, asks Client for the corresponding Polygon, stores the original x/y, and can later recompute that Polygon from the same tile.
A second exact factory accepts rs/a/c entities and obtains their live scene polygon/hull, so the class is broader than a tile-only record and is conservatively named ScenePolygonRecord.
The scene renderer rs/l/b/c consumes these records and passes their Polygon plus fill/outline colors into rs/C.a(Graphics2D, Polygon, Color, Color) for direct scene drawing.

candidates.note: ScenePolygonRecord is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the polygon/color record rendered into the scene. It supports both entity hulls and world-tile polygons, so the name deliberately avoids a narrower tile-only claim. Confidence is 0.997.

evidence.detail: The class owns both a Map<String, ScenePolygonRecord> and a List<ScenePolygonRecord>, with add/update/remove helpers for scene polygons and coordinate-keyed tile polygon entries.
Exact Client initialization constructs one rs/l/e/o instance into Client.aa, making it the live client registry consumed by the scene rendering path.
rs/l/b/c checks both Client.aa collections, iterates their records, and renders every non-null Polygon with the record's fill and outline colors through the scene Graphics2D context.
The manager's static handler field is initialized with rs/l/e/p and registered by R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher as exact ScriptPacket ID 12.

candidates.note: ScenePolygonManager is descriptive recovery for the live Client.aa polygon registry consumed directly by scene rendering. The class manages both entity/list records and coordinate-keyed packet polygons; confidence is 0.997.

evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers ScriptPacket ID 12 from rs/l/e/o.a; exact v308 initializes that field with concrete handler rs/l/e/p.

Selector 0 reads two RGBA color tuples, tile x/y coordinates and an optional String flag/payload, then adds or replaces the coordinate-keyed ScenePolygonRecord through the live Client.aa ScenePolygonManager.
Selector 1 reads tile x/y coordinates and removes the corresponding coordinate-keyed polygon entry from the same ScenePolygonManager.

The records produced by this handler are part of Client.aa and are rendered by rs/l/b/c as actual java.awt.Polygon geometry with their packet-provided fill/outline colors. The optional String is preserved as packet state but is not assigned a narrower semantic role here.

candidates.note: ScenePolygonPacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 12. Its whole surface adds/removes tile-coordinate scene polygons in the exact renderer-consumed polygon registry; confidence is 0.998.
